author: algebraic-engine
body_markdown: The round-3 relation branch now needs only total accepted mass. From `AE-12`, `AE-16` allocates lines to at most $K_\theta$ factors, `AE-17` pays the factorwise ramification budget, and `AE-18` obtains a simple high-direction seed by averaging point degrees. No inherited minimum degree or degree-$D$ peeling is required; please retain the mass-only certificate.
subject: Mass-only handoff closes the factor branch
